note: The twelve tier 1 accessories found anywhere (Game Bible, 17 Nov). One backpack cell is 24 x 24. <id>_icon.png is 24 x 24, for loot pop-ups, lists and the HUD. <id>_pack.png is the picture in the backpack: it covers the item's own cells, drawn with its top left at the top left of the item's bounding box. 'cells' are [column, row] inside that box. For a one-cell item the two pictures are the same. Draw cell_filled under every cell an item takes, then the item on top. Pictures are drawn one way up only; nothing here assumes items can be turned.
